text:
Maria G: FYI PR #27211 is blocked by a flaky e2e: `route_fallback_test` keeps failing on shard-4 (~50%). CI logs show a `KVCacheTimeoutError` around the same point. https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/27211
Ken H: which build? can you paste the failing job link? :eyes:
Maria G: buildkite run: https://buildkite.com/redwood/inference/builds/98765#abc123 — failing job is `e2e-shard-4`
Sanjay P: that looks suspiciously like the flaky we saw last week in release branch. tagging @ops-oncall and @ci-bot to kick off targeted reruns
ci-bot: auto-detected flaky test `route_fallback_test`. Suggested action: run targeted rerun on shard-4. Command:
```\n/buildkite-agent pipeline upload --hook rerun --job e2e-shard-4 --pr 27211
```
ops-oncall: requeued targeted job now (job id 98765-4). will watch results. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Maria G: thanks — quick ask: if reruns are green, can someone approve a snapshot tweak? we changed an expectation in route metrics that might require a snapshot update
Lucy W: prefer not to update snapshots for a nondeterministic failure. if reruns show consistent pass across multiple runs, that's ok, but we should try to reproduce locally first. :+1:
Ken H: rerun results: one pass, one fail. logs show `KVCache miss -> retry` at t=2.3s then timeout at t=5.0s. snippet:
```\n[2026-03-17T12:03:21Z] kvcache.go:312 WARN KVCache miss for key shard-4
[2026-03-17T12:03:24Z] kvcache.go:328 ERROR KVCacheTimeoutError: waited 3s for response
```
Sanjay P: I can try to repro locally with shard-4 config. if it's timing-sensitive we might need to add a small buffer or stub the cache in the test.
Jordan C: I'm not comfortable approving a snapshot change until we know it's a real behavioural change. if you can get 5/5 green on targeted runs I can sign off.
Maria G: ok i'll queue 5 targeted reruns now: `/buildkite trigger rerun --job e2e-shard-4 --count 5`
ci-bot: queued 5 targeted reruns for PR 27211 (jobs 98765-4-a..98765-4-e). updating thread with results.
(ci-bot later): results: 3 passed, 2 failed. summary: flaky persists. marking PR as blocked and assigning to @Sanjay P for local triage. :warning:
Ken H: added a short-term workaround: increase KV cache wait timeout in test harness from 3s -> 6s, but left as a non-committed local patch for reproduction only.
Maria G: thanks everyone. I'll update the PR description with links to the runs and leave it blocked until we have a repro or consistent green runs. ping me if you want me to snapshot the failing logs. :memo:
Sanjay P: i'll take it on and post updates here when I have reproducer steps.
Maria G: great — appreciate it.
